The `Text-*` fonts are geometric fixtures generated by `generate_text_fonts.py`
using only the Python standard library. They contain a space, three simple glyphs,
a distinct replacement glyph, and a visible missing glyph.

Regenerate with `python tests/graphics/testdata/generate_text_fonts.py`.
The checked-in binaries let the C++ tests run without Python or installed fonts.

The fixtures cover TrueType and CFF outlines, collections with complete and partial
style sets, an unrelated family, and variable weight, italic, slant, and optical
size axes. Variable outlines have independently matching static reference files.
The limited weight fixture stops at 600; the slant fixture has no italic axis.
